themes.summary: Elon Musk highlights continuous fixes, features, and powers being added to the Grok AI chatbot, emphasizing user feedback for improvements.

mentions.text:
Try Grok @Bot! You will love it.

We land a few dozen fixes, features and sometimes powers to Bot 7 days a week and we look at your feedback to make Bot as perfect as possible.

themes.topic: Grok AI gift research and purchasing feature
themes.summary: Elon Musk announces a new feature for the Grok AI chatbot, enabling it to research and purchase gifts for friends and family.

mentions.text: Grok @Bot will research gifts that your friends and family would love and buy them
